name: merge_basic_two_lists
spec_quote: The entry keeps `options` = every distinct option of all the lists (first-seen order, no duplicates, never cut, never limited to 12 / 60 / 400) and `option_sets` = the distinct per-form lists (each in the form's own order), only when the merged forms have MORE than one distinct non-empty list; with one list (or none) `option_sets` is absent.

name: answer_second_list_match
spec_quote: When the user's answer is saved (qa_add.py), the answer is checked against the form's options: it must be answerable on at least ONE of the option lists the question was seen with (a pick that matches an option of any list is fine; an answer that matches no option of any list is refused, nothing saved).
